scenicChapters.title: Villages on Kashiragashima Island → Kasuga Village and Sacred Places i
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 65 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

places-ono-village-in-sotome-kasuga-vill.story: A 264 km round trip from Togitsu - roughly 4 h 33 in the saddle. The stops in between: Villages on Kashiragashima Island, Kasuga Village and Sacred Places in Hirado and back through Villages on Kashiragashima Island. The line favours views over speed.
